name: academic-professional-portal-template
description: Professional reusable academic portal template with sample data, static build, PWA, SEO and a human-friendly administration panel.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/routerize.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i assets/css/tailwind-input.css -o dist/assets/css/tailwind.css --minify && node scripts/professionalize.mjs && node scripts/scroll-polish.mjs && node scripts/ui-refinement.mjs && node scripts/showcase.mjs && node scripts/theme-system.mjs
scripts.audit: node scripts/audit.mjs && node scripts/typography-audit.mjs && node scripts/color-audit.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run audit
